in_sanskrit.name: Bisht
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Sacred Fire
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bisht एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishat', meaning 'to spread'. Bisht is a revered name for boys in Hindu tradition, symbolizing the divine presence of the sacred fire god Agni. The name encapsulates bravery, wisdom, and the power to ignite transformation.
